description: This file defines the WebAppCache class, which provides caching for web application information retrieved from component configurations in OFBiz. It is designed to improve performance by memoizing web app info and includes methods for retrieving app info by server and menu. It interacts with external classes like ComponentConfig and WebappInfo, and contains methods with specific roles in managing web app metadata.

classes.name: WebAppCache
classes.description: A cache class for storing and retrieving web application configuration information to improve performance by avoiding repeated config lookups. It manages a synchronized cache of web app info per server and menu, supporting retrieval based on server name and menu, and finding web apps by mount point.

methods.name: WebAppCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with a supplier to fetch component configurations.

methods.name: getAppBarWebInfos
methods.description: Retrieves web app info list visible for a specific server, optionally filtered by menu name, using cache if available or building it otherwise.

methods.name: getWebappInfo
methods.description: Finds the first web app info matching a given web application name within a specific server.

methods.name: getShared
methods.description: Provides access to a singleton shared instance of WebAppCache.
